column1: # Vaisala XMP10 humidity and temperature probe (Modbus RTU) Modbus register map - easymodbus.com - source: https://docs.vaisala.com/r/M213279EN-A/en-US

column15: 0 = One or more errors active; 1 = No errors

column7: Sum of active error codes (see bits).
column15: bit 0 = Temperature measurement error; bit 1 = Humidity measurement error; bit 2 = Humidity sensor failure; bit 3 = Capacitance reference error; bit 4 = Ambient temperature out of range; bit 5 = Firmware checksum mismatch; bit 6 = Device settings corrupted; bit 7 = Additional configuration settings corrupted; bit 8 = Sensor coefficients corrupted; bit 9 = Main configuration settings corrupted; bit 11 = Supply voltage out of range; bit 13 = Non-volatile memory read/write failure

column7: Changes whenever settings or adjustments change.
